subject: Mutual action plan & acceptance tests — draft and timeline
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <jmiles@clearvista.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual action plan & acceptance tests — draft and timeline

Jordan —

Thanks for the productive kickoff earlier. As promised, I attached a first-pass MAP + an appendix of proposed acceptance tests. The goal here is to make the path to a decision explicit so your team can validate signal requirements and we can align on timeline and owners. High-level items in this draft: 

- Success criteria (business + technical) with pass/fail thresholds
- Exit gates for each phase (trial, pilot, production readiness)
- Owner & SLA for each test (latency, accuracy, integration reliability)
- Escalation & rollback triggers (when to pause a rollout)
- Deliverables and dates for both teams

Requests for you: can you confirm 1) the primary success metric for CLV (is it 95% intent classification concordance or something else?), and 2) procurement timeline for PO sign-off (your earlier note said late Sep).

I called out two immediate optional items: a limited synthetic dataset we can use to verify inference latency and a short list of edge-case prompts you want us to include in the acceptance test harness. If you prefer a one-sheet instead of the spreadsheet we can convert.

Next steps I propose: we lock the MAP by Tue (8/18) so engineering can schedule a smoke-run the week of 8/24. If that works for you, I’ll send over a cleaned-up doc with owners and a DocuSign-ready appendix for the trial terms.

Attachments: MAP_CLV-4821_v1.xlsx, acceptance_tests_appendix.pdf

—Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Jordan Miles <jmiles@clearvista.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@clearvista.io>
Date: 2026-08-17T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & acceptance tests — draft and timeline

Ben —

Thanks for the summary and the attachments. I pulled the team in and a few clarifications from our side: 

- Primary success metric: intent concordance is important, but the stakeholder champion (Dr. Kline) wants a proxy that maps to triage reduction: a 12% reduction in manual triage over a 30-day pilot is our target. Please map acceptance tests to that outcome where feasible.
- Procurement timeline: we have an internal review on 9/14; if PoC terms are clean we can sign by 9/21.
- Data for tests: we can share a limited de-identified set for the smoke validation; legal needs a short form NDA amendment (I attached legal@clearvista).

On the MAP itself: overall looks reasonable. A couple of redlines: 
  * Can we shorten the trial phase to two weeks (smoke + initial concordance run) and make the pilot 30 days after that?
  * For latency SLOs, our bar for the user-facing triage UI is 250ms p95, which you may not be able to hit without batching tradeoffs. Can you add an explicit fallback plan (e.g., async scoring + cached suggestions) in the acceptance doc?

I'll loop legal and procurement on the NDA/PO points. If you can update the MAP to show the condensed trial/pilot cadence and the fallback, we can aim to finalize on 8/19.

—Jordan
Jordan Miles
VP Product, ClearVista Health
jmiles@clearvista.io | +1 (212) 555-0987

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-18T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Mutual action plan & acceptance tests — draft and timeline

Karthik/Monica —

Jordan asked for two changes: compress the trial to two weeks (smoke + concordance) and add an explicit latency fallback (async scoring + cache). Procurement expects a signing window around 9/14–9/21. Legal will come back on the NDA amendment which Jordan flagged.

Action checklist for us: 
- Karthik: update the MAP owners & dates to the compressed cadence and confirm that the engineering calendar can run the smoke + pilot as requested. Also call out the PO milestone for forecasting.
- Monica: add fallback language + a simple lambda-based async scoring pattern to the acceptance_tests_appendix.pdf and confirm which infra metrics we will measure (p95 latency, availability, token cost per session).
- Ben: I'll capture the revised MAP and follow up with Jordan by EOD 8/19.

Please keep items minimal — Jordan is looking for a compact, signable plan. We do not want to create unnecessary blockers in the spreadsheet.

—Ben

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <jmiles@clearvista.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Legal <legal@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-19T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & acceptance tests — draft and timeline

Jordan —

Appreciate the quick review. We updated the MAP and the acceptance appendix per your asks: 

- Trial: 2 weeks (week 1: smoke + infra verification; week 2: initial concordance run against de-identified sample). Owner: Redwood engineering (Monica).
- Pilot: 30 days starting immediately after trial. Success metric mapped to triage reduction: we’ll estimate expected triage reduction from concordance + sample labeling and run a daily reconciliation.
- Latency fallback: included an async scoring mode + short-term KV cache for suggested matches; client UI can call a polling endpoint while suggestions populate (doc shows integration pattern).
- Procurement milestone: added procurement sign-off target 2026-09-21 to the MAP and an appendix row for PO/contract owner.

Attached: MAP_CLV-4821_v1.xlsx (updated), acceptance_tests_appendix.pdf (updated). I also added a short note that legal can use as an NDA amendment template — please have your counsel confirm.

Next: if this iteration looks good to you, I’ll convert the MAP to a one-page mutual action plan and send a DocuSign addendum for the trial terms.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: MAP_CLV-4821_v1.xlsx, acceptance_tests_appendix.pdf
